items.mainDefect: GetWebAssets doesn't check entryPointAssetsCache again after taking entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock(), so waiters that lose the race repeat the work and overwrite the cache.

secondary.defect: Holding the exclusive lock during readWebAssetsFromFile/readWebAssetsFromCDN file and network I/O makes every cache miss wait behind blocking I/O.
A transient read error writes a nil result over a valid cached value, which breaks the cache for later Prod callers and returns an error even though a cached value was available.
